record.question: One of the cases mentioned below deals with the plaintiff, as a spectator in a motor car race where the car collided, was hit resulting in injury but was held to be the risk taken by the plaintiff and the defendant not liable.
options: Smith vrs. Charles Baker Auto Racing Club
Hall vrs Brooklands Auto Racing Club
record.explanation: In Hall v. Brooklands Auto Racing Club, a spectator injured in a motor race collision was held to have voluntarily accepted the risk, so the defendants were not liable.
